items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring.
items.implication: BAL WR hierarchy collapses to Bateman/Walker etc; Mark Andrews target bump.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for remaining BAL pass-catchers.

items.text: Rams HC McVay: Puka Nacua will not practice Sat (hip/groin soreness post-Thu), listed Q for MNF vs Giants; likely pregame decision. Not related to camp psoas.
items.why: Hip injury + groin soreness after Thursday practice; second straight miss.
items.implication: GTD; if OUT, TE/Ferguson-Parkinson + Konata Mumpfield/Malachi Fields bump (Whittington doubtful).
items.opportunity: Monitor for role expansion to backups if inactive.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs Patriots with foot injury.
items.implication: PIT WR volume redistribution; affects NE matchup.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunities for other PIT WRs.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT or DOUBTFUL (hamstring) on ETR Sunday injury report; confirmed OUT by Schefter/Rapoport.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practice; history of multi-game hamstring absences.
items.implication: HOU WR crumbs; volume to Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel; Stroud downgrade.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for HOU depth WRs and Schultz.

items.implication: Biggest slate Q per Levitan; impacts Herbert projections heavily; 4pm ET start.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Quentin Johnston etc volume spike.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is biggest injury on the slate, affects so many other projections including Justin Herbert. Game starts 4pm ET. BAL/HOU/NE down to WR crumbs.
items.why: Ribs status uncertainty cascades to Herbert and LAC offense.
items.implication: Herbert downgrade if limited/out; monitor closely for projections update.
items.opportunity: If out, LAC WR hierarchy shifts.

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers (AJ Brown IR); do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in 2026 debut? Unclear vs Stevenson but returning at right time with nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Full practice, 'ready to go'; NE needs explosives; Brown on IR.
items.implication: Potential 10+ touch flex; Stevenson snap share drop from 86%.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes in committee; matchup stretch favorable.

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT or DOUBTFUL on ETR report; Schefter notes doubtful, Raiders elevated TE Myarick and WR White.
items.why: Injury unspecified in report; practice absences implied.
items.implication: LV TE vacuum; Mayer or Myarick opportunity; affects Herbert/McConkey game script.
items.opportunity: TE targets to backups; WR crumbs.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson and Alvin Kamara listed IN.
items.why: Practice full; self-reported ready; expected return.
items.implication: Henderson debut opportunity; Kamara squeezes Etienne role further.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Miller rushes Wk1, 69% fantasy via air; Kamara expected back further squeezes passing role; underdog script.
LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 24%+ target share (tied lead), 74% snaps/21 of 24 RB touches thru 3Q Wk1; Indy allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization Wk1 (tied Bijan lead); 19% tgt share recent; 25+ touches 3 of last 4.
LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz Wk1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz; Bears D soft vs WRs.
LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: career-high 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8; CLE soft vs backs.
